flow.title: Registration
flow.para: Registration with Business Government – Industry Support.

flow.title: Finance
flow.para: Facilitation for goat rearing loan, guidance for documents and actual loan case.

flow.title: Shed Construction
flow.para: Shed construction plan, estimate, quotation, assistance for building permits – actual help with the construction of the shed.

flow.title: Market Guidance
flow.para: Goat breed, price, local market for its purchase and goat shopping center guidance. (purchases must be made by the project owner himself)

flow.title: Vaccination
flow.para: Goat vaccination – annual vaccination, follow up veterinary medicine, guidance medical officer available.

flow.title: Nutrition
flow.para: Ideal feed for goats with mineral co-animal food guidance and availability.

flow.title: Fodder Guidance
flow.para: Green fodder, dry fodder with its guidance as well as seeds available.

flow.title: Sales and Marketing
flow.para: Sales arrangement available for goat marketing and guidance and assistance in actual purchase arrangement.

flow.title: Business Insurance
flow.para: Business insurance guidance and help from Indian government company – United Insurance & the New India Insurance Company has cover.
